title: Object Pool Pattern
overview: Reuse a fixed set of initialised objects rather than creating and destroying them on demand.
useCases: Objects can be frequently reused rather than recreated
exampleUses: A database connection pool that reuses open connections instead of opening a new one per query
A thread pool in a web server that assigns idle threads to incoming requests rather than spawning new ones
A particle system in a game that recycles inactive particle objects instead of allocating new ones each frame
